prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1286; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a left wrist injury, subsequently diagnosed as a distal radius fracture. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the impact and the pattern of the fracture. Over seven visits, care followed a typical course, beginning with immobilization and progressing to supervised range-of-motion exercises as healing advanced. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and the patient returned to daily activities. Examination findings included localized tenderness and reduced grip strength that support the diagnosis, while neurovascular testing and sensation remained within normal limits. Review of the available history found no prior injury to the left wrist or forearm. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good, with follow-up recommended if residual stiffness persists.
